name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
description: Flagship rural housing scheme providing financial assistance to rural homeless households and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses to construct pucca houses with basic amenities.
target_beneficiaries: Households living in zero, one or two-room kutcha houses identified by SECC 2011 and Awaas+ survey
benefits: Direct grant assistance of Rs. 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs. 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP areas, plus 90/95 days of unskilled labour under MGNREGS (approx. Rs. 27,000) and Rs. 12,000 for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India.
Centrally sponsored rural housing scheme implemented across rural areas of all States and UTs.
Rural families living in kutcha houses or without shelter as identified by SECC 2011 deprivation criteria and Gram Sabha verified Awaas+ list.
Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in difficult areas disbursed directly in installments tied to construction milestones, coupled with MGNREGA wages.
Official AwaasSoft management portal hosted at pmayg.nic.in.
Cabinet approved extension through March 2029 with a target to construct 2 crore additional rural houses under PMAY-G 2.0.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Beneficiary must not own a pucca house anywhere in India and must not have any member in regular government service.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: UIDAI Aadhaar of head of household and family members.

required_documents.title: MGNREGA Job Card
required_documents.description: Valid Job Card for linking labour assistance wages.

required_documents.title: Bank Passbook
required_documents.description: Aadhaar-seeded bank account details for direct installment transfers.

required_documents.title: Homestead Land Title / Possession Document
required_documents.description: Proof of ownership or legal possession of homestead plot for house construction.
